models_evaluated: twelve LLMs (names not given in text)

links.outcome: Readability (SMOG, FKGL) of LLM patient explanations by prompt technique versus 6th grade target
links.effect: No prompt technique or model consistently produced outputs at or below 6th grade level by SMOG (p<0.001); more constrained prompts yielded significantly more readable outputs (p<0.001).
links.quote: No prompt technique or model consistently produced outputs at or below a 6th grade reading level when assessed by the SMOG index, the preferred metric when assessing healthcare materials (p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Reading level of LLM-generated patient materials relative to recommended 6th grade level
links.effect: No prompt technique or model consistently produced output at or below 6th grade SMOG level; less constrained prompts produced less readable outputs across 2655 outputs.
links.quote: No prompt technique or model consistently produced outputs at or below a 6th grade reading level when assessed by the SMOG index, the preferred metric when assessing healthcare materials (p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering (constrained, persona, meta, contextualized prompts) to improve readability of LLM patient materials

screen.reason: Empirically tests and compares multiple prompt engineering strategies (e.g. constraints, persona, meta-prompts) to evaluate their effectiveness as a safeguard/control for reading level readability in patient materials.

primary.practice: prompt engineering for reading level constraints
